displayPattern: Amber LED on a Bryant 80% two-stage variable-speed furnace (troubleshooting guide TG-GFB80-02). Short flashes are the first digit and long flashes are the second. Code 41 is 4 short and 1 long
meaning: Blower motor fault. The blower failed to reach 250 RPM, or failed to communicate, within 30 seconds after being turned on or within 10 seconds during steady-state operation.
causes: Blower did not reach 250 RPM within 30 seconds of being turned on
Blower did not communicate within 30 seconds of being turned on
During steady running, the blower missed 250 RPM or communication within 10 seconds
diySteps: Count 4 short flashes and 1 long flash. If this happened on two heating cycles in a row, the chart stores lockout 15
Technician: the component-test line for code 41 says to check the blower, the wiring, and the furnace control
safetyNote: If you smell gas, do not touch any electrical switch or use a phone in the building; leave immediately and call your gas supplier from outside. Turn off electrical power at the furnace switch or breaker before opening any panel, and never bypass or jumper a limit, rollout or pressure switch. Gas valve, burner, venting, wiring and control-board work should be done by a licensed HVAC technician.
proAdvice: Call a licensed HVAC technician. Blower RPM and communication checks are not a homeowner meter job.
sourceTitle: Bryant 80% variable-speed two-stage furnace troubleshooting guide (Catalog No. TG-GFB80-02)
